data.case_title: Order to trim hedge – Landratsamt Beispielkreis (Az. 32-1712/2026-044)
data.explanation: The county office (Landratsamt) has issued a formal order (Anordnung) requiring you to cut back your hedge to the property line because it protrudes into the sidewalk and blocks visibility at a road junction. If you disagree, you can file a written or electronic objection (Widerspruch) with the Landratsamt by the deadline shown, which the app will calculate for you – do not state a computed date yourself. If no objection is filed and the order becomes legally final (bestandskräftig), you then have three weeks from that point to actually trim the hedge. Since this involves a public-safety issue (sight lines at a junction), it may be worth acting promptly or consulting a lawyer if you want to contest the order.

items.title: Object to the order (Widerspruch einlegen)

date.text: binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist

items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.action: File a written or electronic objection (Widerspruch), or have one recorded in person, with Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, if you disagree with the order.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed, the order becomes legally final (bestandskräftig) and the three-week period to trim the hedge begins to run.

items.title: Cut back the hedge to the property line (Hecke zurückschneiden)

date.text: innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids

items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.action: Trim the hedge back to the property boundary, within three weeks after the order becomes legally final (i.e. after the objection period ends without an objection, or after an objection is resolved).

data.summary: The Landratsamt Beispielkreis (Sachgebiet 32 – Öffentliche Sicherheit und Ordnung) has ordered Jonas Mustermann, under Art. 29 BayStrWG, to cut back a hedge that protrudes up to 1.20 m into the sidewalk near Kreisstraße RO 5 and blocks visibility at a junction, back to the property line. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification, and once the order becomes final, the hedge must be trimmed within three weeks (Az. 32-1712/2026-044, dated 29.06.2026).
